title: Hardware backdoors in some x86 CPUs
summary: Rosenbridge is a research project exposing undocumented hardware backdoors found in certain x86 CPUs, demonstrating how hidden functionality can exist within processor firmware that bypasses normal security boundaries.
problem_solved: Reveals and documents undocumented backdoor mechanisms embedded in x86 CPU hardware that could compromise system security.
why_valuable: Critical for hardware security research, helping the security community understand and defend against stealthy hardware-level vulnerabilities that traditional software security cannot detect.
